notes: Hotfix: v3.5.0's packaged app failed to launch ('Cannot find module ./db.js') because the SQLite storage module wasn't copied into the asar build - the build now ships src/main/db.js alongside wsServer.js. Also hardened the single-instance handler so a second launch can no longer hit a 'mainWindow before initialization' error. If you installed 3.5.0, install this build over it - your data is untouched.
